verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an agentic commerce platform, but the evidence documents no user-facing retention settings, data-deletion requests, or erasure APIs. The only related items are fixed system behaviours: carts have a long TTL, checkouts are short-lived, and cancel_cart is a cart-lifecycle operation. None of these are controls over data retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
